title: Durable erasure discovery, retries and honest receipts
scope: Preserve exact erasure discovery before destructive steps; durably resume bounded per-target local cleanup on the existing operator POST and existing storage, with honest partial/physical-destination status.
non_goals: Partial W06/F04/F06/F18/N05/N12/N13 and customer35 section4 first-party identity/erasure/warehouse deletion only. No full W06/finding/gate/customer/release acceptance; no replay barrier/epoch, concurrent ingestion/new-generation cross-store transaction, uncapped/orphan discovery, CACHE/seen/D1/historic telemetry/external reconciliation or physical rewrite completion.

Same normalized original selector resumes a pending local job; no cross-selector/person-wide job coordination, automatic scheduler or new endpoint/queue/binding. Pending necessary recovery records and minimal completion metadata do not approve D01/D03/D06 topology, authority or retention policy. Customer/privacy approval remains required before real data.

Four production paths and two existing suites only. No general SessionManager/ShopperReflex/index/SDK/scorer changes, infrastructure validation programme, extra suite/build or broad matrix. Reuse unchanged dependency assurance without whole-task reacceptance. No stage/commit/push/deploy/cloud/credentials/customer-data/destructive/unrelated operations or subdelegation.

criteria.description: Strict tenant-bound durable job under existing R2 erasures namespace, keyed by SHA256 of normalized exact original request selector; validate stored schema/tenant/selector/targets. Persist immutable discovered IDs, exact session/pointer/link targets, original actor/cutoff and configured destinations before any deletion. Reject inconsistent requested IDs/current relinks or corrupt/read-failed discovery before effects. Conditional create and ETag-guarded per-object checkpoints; lost/ambiguous/failed checkpoint stops executor. Same selector resumes pending after links/pointers disappear; completed local job becomes minimal non-profile checkpoint metadata and a later explicit request starts fresh discovery/cutoff. Never erase pending discovery or reset progress to mask errors. Bounded maximum32 attempted work steps per invocation, with visible manual continuation; no cross-store or cross-selector transaction claim.

Delete only captured tenant-scoped targets with strict direct KV operations, not error-swallowing SessionManager helpers. Clean both configured profile hosts independent of current REFLEX_HOST; validate actual ShopperReflex and DecisionRing reset acknowledgments. Frozen required binding loss remains failure, not unbound success. Check target/current-link compatibility before destructive work and remove known links only after corresponding local target work is checkpointed. Separate tombstone and ring stages; strict same-or-earlier-cutoff tombstone retries retain counts/done_through and actor, genuinely later erasure restarts the window. Preserve direct ledger-helper compatibility except truthful failure. Response distinguishes local completion/pending/error and overall complete:false; legacy erased:[] until physical/external erasure proven, separate local-completed/target status. Failed stages/read/write/conflict never ok:true;200 only local completion,202 bounded continuation,409 conflict,503 storage/destination failure. Explicit unbound/historical/orphan/cache/D1/physical/replay/external limits; no raw payload/error logging.

Existing identity-route and ledger-erasure suites only: meaningful actual destination deletion, both bound profile hosts, two non-default tenant separation, discovery/read/create/checkpoint/ambiguous-write/CAS failures, reconstructed same-selector retry after lost keys, conflicting initial/resumed links, bound work continuation, fixed original cutoff and completed-job fresh erase. Extend existing FakeR2 with conditional metadata semantics; use actual reset classes where practical and label synthetic seams. Worker exact K1, app noEmit and scoped before/current diff; independent exact K1 once plus actual frozen source/full available evidence/local import graph/pins. Qualify W05.08 shared-input proof before edits, preserve implementation/history. No native/deployed/SLO or full historical-task assurance.
